title: Fan out over changed files
prompt: I want a workflow that looks at what changed on my branch compared with main, reviews every changed file separately and in parallel (no more than 4 at a time, and it must not edit anything), and then writes one combined review. Put it in GeneratorAI as a draft.

shape: a scan agent stage (read-only) whose output is JSON with a typed list of files
a map stage whose items is that list (stages.<scan>.output.files or a mapped field), concurrency <= 4, a maxItems bound, workspace shared
a read-only body agent stage (parentKey = the map key) that reviews {{item}}
a report stage after the map reading stages.<map>.output.results
no post-processing commit, push or PR

pass: the plan is shown to the user before the draft is created
the draft is created, not published or run
no forbidden fields (as in eval 01); every stage that only reads has permissionMode plan; no map-shared-write-concurrency warning left unexplained
the map reads a typed list: no expr-type or expr-unknown-field errors on the final document
